title: The Rising 25
lede: Twenty-five early-stage startups to watch. Seed to Series B, mostly US, picked for fresh money, strong backers and real traction.
rules: Seed, Series A or Series B
method: Every company here is already on the Well Run board. We start with the ones whose latest round is Seed, Series A or Series B and whose headquarters and most of the team are in the US. Then we rank by promise: how recent and how strong the last round was, who led it, real traction (revenue, customers, usage), and hiring momentum. Each pick gets a fresh check for layoffs, lawsuits and down rounds; anything unresolved stays off. Hand-picked, updated as rounds land. Each line links to its source.

picks.name: Traversal
picks.why: Hit a $1B valuation 17 months out of stealth; ARR grew 9x this year as Pepsi, Amex and Nubank put its AI SRE on production.

picks.name: Rox
picks.why: AI revenue agents for the Global 2000; ARR up 10x in its first year in market, now valued at $1.3B.

picks.name: Arena
picks.why: The AI leaderboard turned business: run-rate went from $30M in January to $100M+ by June, and its valuation nearly doubled to $3.1B.

picks.name: Prime Intellect
picks.why: Open training stack for AI agents; past $100M in annualized revenue in under a year with 6,000+ customers.

picks.name: Wispr Flow
picks.why: Voice dictation people actually switched to: revenue up 30x year over year, valuation nearly tripled to $2B in nine months.

picks.name: Charta Health
picks.why: AI chart review for medical billing; revenue up 10x in 12 months, third round in under two years.

picks.name: Pace
picks.why: AI agents for insurance back offices at Prudential and WTW; ARR up 15x+ through the first three quarters of 2026.

picks.name: Parallel Web Systems
picks.why: Web search built for AI agents; 100,000+ developers and a $2B valuation five months after its A.

picks.name: Basis
picks.why: AI agents that do accounting firm work; now in roughly 40% of the top 25 US firms, team up 2.5x in a year.

picks.name: 7AI
picks.why: Largest Series A in cybersecurity history; its SOC agents passed 7M investigations and it is adding 100 jobs in Boston.

picks.name: Monaco
picks.why: AI-native sales platform from Sam Blond; went from zero revenue in February to adding seven figures of ARR a month.

picks.name: XDOF
picks.why: Robot training data out of stealth in June; revenue run-rate near $50M and already in talks for a B at $1.2B.

picks.name: Broccoli AI
picks.why: AI front desk for home-services businesses; $15M+ ARR in under two years across 1,500+ businesses.

picks.name: Albert Invent
picks.why: Chemistry-native AI for R&D at BASF, Henkel and Kenvue; scientists on the platform up 6x in a year.

picks.name: Confido
picks.why: Back office for consumer brands; 250+ brands including Mars and Unilever divisions, 5x growth since its A.

picks.name: General Medicine
picks.why: The PillPack founders' healthcare store; 2,900+ priced services and a16z bio's largest check to date.

picks.name: Canals
picks.why: AI order entry for wholesale distributors; profitable before raising, 100+ distributors, headcount about 3x in a year.

picks.name: Qualitate
picks.why: AI-run expert interviews for investors and corporates; run rate up 10x+ in 2026 with net revenue retention over 300%.

picks.name: Stuut
picks.why: AI agents for accounts receivable; raised its B ten months after its A, with most collections now running hands-free.

picks.name: Tessera Labs
picks.why: Automates SAP and ERP overhauls; multimillion-dollar Fortune 500 contracts and a team that nearly tripled since May.

picks.name: Resolve AI
picks.why: AI for production incidents at Coinbase and DoorDash; $1.5B valuation and bookings up 128% quarter over quarter.

picks.name: Juicebox
picks.why: AI recruiting search; ARR tripled since its 2025 Series A and 5,000+ customers.

picks.name: BackOps
picks.why: AI that resolves supply chain exceptions; claims volume up 150x at one customer, team about 3x in a year.

picks.name: Picogrid
picks.why: Software that connects military systems; revenue tripled year over year and it is cash-flow positive.

picks.name: AegisAI
picks.why: Ex-Google security leads stopping AI spear phishing; went from 3 paying customers to dozens in ten months.
